description: Test cases for offshore wind farm electrical collector system planning is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Haowei Yang. This is the dataset for the paper "Optimal Planning of Offshore Wind Farm Collector System under the Economical and Intensive Use of Sea Areas". Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 8 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 22247 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
name: Test cases for offshore wind farm electrical collector system planning
notes: Harvested from Figshare on 2026-09-29 in the round 2 research-repositories pass, selected by keyword match and title review; publisher recorded in the metadata: figshare.
